transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer technical services. My name is Gareth. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Gareth. I am having a severe, dangerous problem with my S-Net Samsung Galaxy S23. Over the last three weeks, the battery has deteriorated to the point where it goes from one hundred percent fully charged down to zero and abruptly dies within forty minutes of light use! It completely shuts down without warning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly investigate that rapid battery depletion issue for you. Before we query the diagnostic telemetry servers, may I please verify the full billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 12 Victoria Square, Swansea, SA1 4DF. And my security question answer is my favourite sports team, Swansea City.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the mobile account records. What is the mobile telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The number is 07700 900388. Gareth, last Friday night my car broke down on a deserted, unlit stretch of the M4 motorway in heavy pouring rain! I pulled onto the hard shoulder and dialed the RAC breakdown service, but while I was explaining my exact location, the phone suddenly dropped from sixty percent to black and died completely! I was stranded in the dark for two freezing hours in terror, unable to call for help while lorries were thundering past at seventy miles an hour! I was terrified for my life! Having a phone that dies within forty minutes is an absolute death trap!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the absolute terror of being stranded on an unlit motorway hard shoulder in the dark and rain when your mobile phone abruptly dies, and worrying about your physical safety during breakdown emergencies is horrifying, so let us prioritize running an over-the-air battery cell diagnostic immediately and book a replacement battery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Gareth, that experience shook me up terribly, so I need this sorted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am initiating a remote Knox diagnostic query across the cellular data link to pull the power management IC telemetry.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the remote battery diagnostic show?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The battery management controller registers eight hundred and forty charge cycles and reports a maximum cell capacity of sixty-two percent of design specification.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sixty-two percent capacity! Does that mean the lithium battery is physically degraded?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Manufacturer engineering standards designate any battery falling below eighty percent health within the twenty-four-month contract window as defective.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So it qualifies for a free battery replacement under warranty?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under S-Net's Handset Lifetime Care promise, degraded batteries on active pay-monthly plans are replaced free of charge at an authorized Samsung service center.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where is the nearest authorized service center to Swansea?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are there any physical signs of battery swelling, such as the back glass lifting away from the aluminum chassis or screen discoloration?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Inspecting the phone case... no, the glass back is completely flush with the metal frame and the screen has zero discoloration.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the internal pouch has not suffered thermal runaway expansion, meaning it is safe for standard bench servicing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I book a same-day battery replacement appointment?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you charge your phone overnight with cheap corner-shop chargers, you only have yourself to blame for ruining the lithium cells.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I only ever use the original official Samsung fast charger that came with the phone! How dare you make insulting assumptions about my charging habits! I expect common courtesy from technical support!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the authorized repair booking calendar for our Swansea city centre repair branch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What times are available for tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An authorized walk-in repair timeslot has been reserved for eleven o'clock tomorrow morning at the S-Net Swansea High Street branch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will the technicians take to install the new battery?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In-branch battery replacements take approximately forty-five minutes, including water-resistance gasket resealing and vacuum pressure testing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the phone will retain its IP68 water resistance rating after the new battery is fitted?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms manufacturer-certified laser gasket thermal sealing will restore factory water ingress protection specifications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me total confidence in the quality of the repair.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How long does your phone battery typically last on a full charge before dropping to zero?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Gareth, as I told you in my very first sentence, it dies within forty minutes! We just diagnosed that the cell health is at sixty-two percent!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, that was a standard verification prompt on the repair intake form.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please pay attention so you don't ask for information you already have.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. The diagnostic intake logs forty minutes runtime under active cellular load.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to back up my phone data before handing it over to the technician tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, enable Samsung Smart Switch cloud backup or back up your handset to a computer before servicing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will run a full backup to my home laptop tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also toggle Samsung 'Maintenance Mode' under Device Care before handing the phone over so your private photos and messages remain locked.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Maintenance Mode is brilliant because it protects my banking and private messages from technicians.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Technicians can run hardware diagnostic routines while personal data partitions are isolated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do I need to bring to the store tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bring the handset and a photo ID such as your driving licence or passport, along with booking reference REP-99104.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Booking reference REP-99104. I have noted that down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the cellular reception and 5G network performance in your area while we have your profile open.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at the phone screen... it displays full four bars of 5G here in Swansea.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cell mast telemetry confirms optimal carrier aggregation throughput across bands one, three, and twenty-eight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The 5G data speeds have always been blazing fast when the battery stays alive.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The battery replacement will restore standard eight-hour screen-on time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give me peace of mind on the motorway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your contract status to confirm your remaining term length.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How many months do I have left on this contract?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your Unlimited 5G Max contract runs for another fourteen months, with full hardware warranty coverage active throughout.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is great to know that the warranty covers the phone for the whole duration.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If any further battery capacity degradation occurs, a second replacement is covered at zero charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is excellent customer service protection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, your repair appointment is reserved for eleven AM tomorrow at Swansea High Street, booking REP-99104.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, eleven AM tomorrow at Swansea High Street. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this repair ticket and ensure the service centre technician logs battery completion tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the repair appointment booked so fast, Gareth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Gareth, before we finish, what if I am delayed in traffic on the way into Swansea? Can I reschedule to...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Call back if you are late. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Gareth, don't hang up... hello? He hung up on me!
